text: と　かかれた　ペナントは　ないのかね？
note: Pennants printed with a place name were a classic souvenir sold at Japanese tourist spots, so he is asking the shop for the usual tourist goods.
claim: Triangular pennants printed with a place name were a common souvenir at Japanese tourist spots in the Showa era.

check.quote: １９５０年代から８０年代前半まで、お土産屋には必ずあった地名入りのペナント。
